---
title: "HDF5 compatibility"
---

ToFScope reads supported [*TOFWERK*](#trademark-notice) *TOFexplorer* HDF5 acquisitions and saves analyses as new HDF5 copies. The original acquisition remains unchanged. The [file compatibility guide](31-file-compatibility.qmd) describes supported files and preparation.

## Reopening an analysis

A saved copy contains the acquisition, committed analysis settings, and full-resolution custom results. ToFScope can reopen the copy and restore the analysis, including its signals and display settings. The [saving guide](../using-tofscope/14-saving-and-exports.qmd) describes what a copy preserves.

## Using a copy in *TOFexplorer*

Some saved copies have opened in *TOFexplorer*, but ToFScope analysis names and custom signals may not appear as vendor peak channels. ToFScope stores its analysis metadata separately, and *TOFexplorer* is not known to interpret all of it.

For a signal made from disjoint mass intervals, vendor peak bounds may span the gaps between intervals. Those bounds do not fully describe the signal; ToFScope retains the exact intervals in its analysis metadata.

## Limits of compatibility

Opening a file in *TOFexplorer* does not establish that all metadata is interchangeable or that the applications produce identical numerical results. Numerical agreement, commercial editing and resaving, and a complete *TOFexplorer* round trip of the current **Save as** workflow remain unverified.

## Trademark notice
